triggering_validation_record.observed_gap: Every memoryless candidate failed the frozen gates. Persistence achieved 0.8289% geometric H1/H3/H5 error, the deployed simulator JEPA reached 5.1696%, and the best attack-window result was 4/14. Increasing instantaneous-model capacity did not solve temporal process dynamics.

permitted_change: Add past-only temporal context to the HAI-specific diagnostic branch. Do not change the deployed simulator PJE1 artifact, HAI projection, file split, raw labels, final-test policy, or authority boundary.
candidate_families: HAI-specific temporal EMA-target JEPA transition predictor

allowed: the current and preceding masked projected states
past and contemporaneous registered control features

residual_score_candidates: maximum per-dimension residual standardized by normal-calibration median absolute deviation
mean of the three largest standardized per-dimension residuals
five-second exponentially weighted mean of the mean-top-three score
thirty-second exponentially weighted mean of the mean-top-three score
threshold_policy: Each candidate score calibrates its threshold on hai-train4 normal data only. HAI test1 labels may select the context/model/score candidate. Alert persistence and the two-alerts-per-hour ceiling remain unchanged.

selection_policy.primary: lowest validation geometric H1/H3/H5 masked transition error among candidates passing every original validation gate
tie_breakers: lower validation false alerts per hour

authority_boundary: The temporal HAI model remains a separate, advisory diagnostic branch. It cannot grant permits, block commands, approve goals, invoke adapters, or actuate hardware.
